exercises.audioText: It is Saturday. Rose and Nan are in the town. They are in a cafe opposite the bank. Rose is reading a magazine. Nan is writing an email. They are waiting. The ice cream is delicious.

exercises.audioText: Leo is a customer in a shop in the town. The shop sells shoes. Leo tries on a pair of black shoes. They cost five hundred baht. That is expensive. Dan pays by card.

exercises.audioText: Rose is in the centre of the town. She has a map. The library is west of the market. The museum is behind the library. The hospital is north of the bank.

Leo reads a message from Rose: "Turn left at the bank. The cafe is opposite the bank. I am waiting in the cafe." Leo and Nan find the bank and the cafe.
